title: enhance-unified-rollouts-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-observability-and-safety-guards
author: Aisha Morales
description:
Summary: Improve safety, observability, and stability for unified rollouts (canary, A/B, shadow) by enhancing autorollback decisioning, adding new telemetry/metrics, and introducing additional e2e stability guards.

Motivation: We observed a handful of incidents where progressive rollouts did not surface regressions quickly enough (regression detection delayed by noisy metrics and insufficient quorum logic). This PR tightens quorum/metric matching logic, adds richer tracing and per-route rollout telemetry, and provides safety gates (manual quarantine step + automatic short-circuit) to reduce blast radius. This work is part of ENG-9982 and addresses customer escalations tracked in SUP-1245.

What changed (high level):
- Rollout engine: strengthened metric quorum evaluation and multi-metric composite scoring used for autorollback decisions. Added configurable grace windows to avoid false positives from transient spikes.
- Shadow/Canary routing: added explicit probing stages and a short-lived quarantine state to pause traffic to suspect variants while investigations run.
- Observability: new rollout_* metrics (rollout_progress, rollout_quarantine_count, autorollback_reasons) and tracing spans for rollout decision path. Dashboards updated.
- Safety guards: new e2e stability harness that runs against canary variants before automatic promotion; added threshold hysteresis and cooldown periods.
- Tests & docs: integration + e2e tests added; rollout docs and migration notes for existing custom policies.

- [x] Performance regression benchmarks run (no meaningful latency regression)
- [x] Updated docs and migration notes

Testing and validation:
- Unit tests added for quorum logic and composite-metric evaluation.
- Integration tests against a local cluster simulating noisy metrics and partial failures.
- New e2e harness runs staged-shadow -> canary -> promote flows and validates quarantine/autorollback triggers.
- Performance: ran microbenchmarks on 1000 request bursts; median latency change < 2% and throughput unchanged.

Rollback safety notes:
- Autorollback now requires either (a) composite score crossing threshold with quorum from >= 3 independent metrics OR (b) a single critical metric breach with confirmed probe failure.
- Grace windows (default 30s) and cooldown periods (default 5m) reduce flapping.
- Quarantine state prevents promotion but still allows shadow probing and emits high-priority alerts for on-call.

Merge notes & follow-ups:
- Merged via squash with commit message: "enhance rollouts: quorum + telemetry + safety guards for canary/AB/shadow autorollback".
- Post-merge follow-ups tracked in ENG-10010 (dashboard tweaks) and ENG-10011 (SLO adjustments based on new telemetry).
- Ops runbook updated (docs/rollouts/oncall_quarantine_runbook.md) — please review and sync with SRE rotation.

Release notes:
- Added stronger autorollback decisioning using composite metrics and quorum logic.
- New rollout telemetry and dashboards for faster troubleshooting.
- Quarantine state and stability guards for canary/AB/shadow flows reduce risk of noisy promotions.

Why this is safe: changes are guarded behind rollout policy defaults; default thresholds mirror previous behavior plus extra observability. No breaking API changes; migration notes included.
